buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card.

b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 4. Generic Non return of Hard Disk: As per Buyer organization’s Security Policy,Faulty Hard Disk of Servers/Desktop Computers/ Laptops etc. will not be returned back to the OEM/supplier against warranty replacement. 5. Generic NON DISCLOSURE DECLARATION CERTIFICATE (On Bidder Letter Head) to be uploaded with bid: 1. I M/s. project officer hereby declare that I shall not disclose the contract or any provision, specification, plan, design, pattern, sample or information thereof to any third party during and after expiry of Contract. 2. If defying the norms as per the Contract a legal action may be taken against me as per the existing Rules. 6. OEM IMPORTED PRODUCTS: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India. The certificate to this effect should be submitted. 7. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 8. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 9. Certificates The bidder is required to upload, along with the bid, all relevant certificates such as BIS licence, type test certificate, approval certificates and other certificates as prescribed in the Product Specification given in the bid document. 10. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 11. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL / SPECIAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS FOR PROCUREMENT OF LAPTOP 1. GST Certificate: The bidder shall upload a valid GST Registration Certificate. 2. PAN Certificate: The bidder shall upload a valid PAN Card/ PAN Certificate.

3. Udyam Registration: The bidder shall upload a valid Udyam Registration Certificate, wherever applicable. 4. Non-Blacklisting Undertaking: The Bidder/OEM (themselves or through authorized reseller(s)) shall submit an undertaking on non-judic ial stamp paper of Rs. 100/- stating that the firm/OEM has not been blacklisted/debarred by any Central/St ate Government Department, Government Organisation or PSU as on the date of submission of the bid. 5. Right of Buyer: The Buyer reserves the right to accept or reject/cancel the tender in accordance with applicable GeM ter ms and conditions. 6. Submission of Documents: All requisite documents/certificates required under the bid shall be uploaded by the bidder before the bi d closing date and time. Documents submitted after the bid closing date/time shall not be considered. 7. Sample/Demonstration: The bidder shall provide a sample/demo unit, if specifically called for by the Buyer/Technical Evaluation Committee. Failure to provide the required sample/demo may result in rejection of the bid. 8. Bid Splitting: The bid shall not be split. The complete requirement shall be supplied by the successful bidder as per th e terms of the contract. 9. Tender Condition Acceptance: The bidder shall upload a duly signed and stamped copy of the Tender Conditions Acceptance Certificate along with the bid. 10. Non-Disclosure Certificate: The bidder shall submit a duly signed Non-Disclosure/Confidentiality Undertaking, wherever applicable. 11. Annual Turnover: The bidder shall submit annual turnover certificates duly certified/audited by a Chartered Accountant fo r the last three financial years, wherever stipulated in the bid. 12. Past Supply/Order Experience: The bidder shall submit documentary evidence of supply orders/contracts for similar items executed wit h Government Departments/Organisations/PSUs, wherever such experience is stipulated in the bid. 13. Experience Requirement: The seller should have the minimum experience specified in the bid document in supply of laptops/comp uters or related IT equipment, wherever applicable. 14. Pre-Bid Meeting (Mandatory): It is mandatory for all participating bidders to attend the Pre-Bid Meeting, wherever scheduled as manda tory in the bid, to obtain necessary clarifications regarding the equipment/products and technical specifica tions mentioned in the bid document. Note: Non-attendance of the mandatory Pre-Bid Meeting may result in disqualification/rejection of the bi d, as per the bid conditions. 15. Certificate of Incorporation/Registration: The bidder shall upload a copy of the Certificate of Incorporation/Registration issued by the competent a uthority in India, wherever applicable. 16. MSME Registration: The seller should be registered under MSME/Udyam, wherever applicable. 17. OEM/Authorised Channel Partner: The bidder shall submit valid OEM authorisation or proof of being an authorised channel partner/reseller, wherever required under the bid conditions. 18. Genuine and New Product: The Laptop supplied shall be brand new, unused and genuine, and shall not be refurbished, reconditione d, repaired or used/demo stock. 19. Make and Model: The bidder shall clearly mention the Make, Model, Part Number and complete configuration of the Lapto p offered in the technical bid. 20. Technical Compliance: The offered Laptop shall strictly conform to all technical specifications mentioned in the bid. The bidder shall submit a duly signed and stamped Technical Compliance Statement against each specification. 21. Operating System and Software: The Laptop shall be supplied with genuine and properly licensed Operating System and other software a s specified in the technical specifications. Appropriate licence/authenticity details shall be provided with th e equipment. 22. OEM Warranty: The Laptop shall be covered by a minimum 03 years comprehensive OEM warranty, or as specified in th e bid/GeM product specification, from the date of successful delivery and acceptance. 23. After-Sales Support: The Seller/OEM shall provide adequate after-sales technical support during the warranty period. Any ma

nufacturing defect arising during the warranty period shall be repaired/replaced by the Seller/OEM without any additional cost to the Buyer. 24. Serial Number Verification: The serial number, model number and other identification details of each Laptop shall be clearly visible on the equipment and shall correspond with the invoice/delivery documents. 25. Inspection and Acceptance: The Laptop shall be subject to inspection by the Buyer/Technical Inspection Committee. The equipment shall be accepted only after satisfactory verification of its make, model, configuration, serial number and c ompliance with the stipulated technical specifications. 26. Replacement of Defective Equipment: Any Laptop found defective, damaged or not conforming to the approved technical specifications at the time of inspection/acceptance shall be replaced by the Seller at no additional cost to the Buyer. 27. Packing and Transportation: The equipment shall be properly packed to prevent damage during transportation and handling. Any da mage attributable to improper packing or transportation shall be rectified/replaced by the Seller at no addi tional cost to the Buyer. 28. Delivery Documents: The Seller shall provide the original invoice, warranty documents, OEM warranty details and other relev ant documents along with the Laptop at the time of delivery. 29. Product Configuration: No change in the approved make, model, processor, RAM, storage, display or any other major configura tion shall be permitted without prior approval of the Buyer. 30. Compliance with GeM Terms: All terms and conditions of the GeM General Terms and Conditions (GTC), applicable Special Terms and Conditions (STC) and the Bid Document shall remain applicable. In case of any conflict, the applicable GeM terms and conditions shall prevail. 31. The Laptop Shall not be of Chinese brand or chinese origin. .
